messages:
maria.fp: FYI CloudInsight sent an updated quote and SOW for their cost monitoring + alerting suite. link: https://cloudinsight.example.com/redwood-sow :eyes:
jonathan-s: thanks — can you paste the summary numbers here? I can't access that link from my laptop network rn.
devex-ryan: curious about ingestion pricing — is it per-embedding, per-batch, or per-API-call?
cloudinsight-sales: hi everyone, quick summary from our side — pricing has three tiers: PAYG, 12mo commit, 24mo commit. PAYG: $0.20 / 1k embeddings ingested, $0.003 / 1k evaluation events. 12mo: 12% off PAYG; 24mo: 22% off PAYG + extra 2 months credit. happy to provide sample invoice lines.
maria.fp: can you share a sample invoice row for monthly usage of 50M embeddings and 10M eval events? also need to know if analytics API calls are metered separately.
cloudinsight-sales: sure — sample (rounded):
```
Line item: embeddings.ingest
Qty: 50,000 units (1k units)
Rate: $0.20 / unit
Amount: $10,000.00
Line item: events.eval
Qty: 10,000 units (1k units)
Rate: $0.003 / unit
Amount: $30.00
Total: $10,030.00
```
jonathan-s: ok math checks out. what about minimum commitments / overage rules?
cloudinsight-sales: commit = monthly minimum based on annualized commit. overage billed at PAYG rates above committed threshold. we also allow banking of unused credits in 12mo + 24mo up to 3 months.
procurement-bot: Reminder: Purchases > $50k/yr require Procurement + Legal approval. Please attach SOW and pricing appendix.
maria.fp: legal will want termination language — any early termination fees? what is the SLA and credits?
cloudinsight-sales: early termination: pro-rated refund of unused prepaid months minus implementation costs (capped). SLA: 99.9% uptime for control plane; inference ingestion throughput SLAs in dedicated plan only. Credits: 5% monthly credit for each 30m downtime window after 99.9 threshold.
devex-ryan: can we get an engineering appendix — latency percentiles on ingestion pipeline and retention durations for raw logs? we need 90/95/99 P95 ingest latency for 1M events/day baseline.
cloudinsight-sales: appendix attached in SOW v2 — short excerpt: P95 ingest latency 120ms for standard plan at 1M/day; 60ms for dedicated. retention: raw logs 90 days by default, optional 365-day for an extra fee.
jonathan-s: one more finance ask — what's invoicing cadence? monthly in arrears or prepaid? payment terms?
cloudinsight-sales: default is monthly in arrears, Net30. Prepay options available for committed plans (monthly amortized).
maria.fp: ok. propose we pilot PAYG for 2 months with $5k trial credit and then evaluate switching to 12mo commit. can you send a PO-ready quote with these options and confirm no early termination penalties for pilot?
cloudinsight-sales: we can do a $5k trial credit, no termination penalty for the pilot period. will send PO-ready quote by EOD.
procurement-bot: Next step: attach quote + SOW to procurement ticket #PR-2026-348, flag for Legal if > $50k.
jonathan-s: +1 to pilot. I'll run a quick TCO: can someone DM me sample token/embedding counts for our typical prod workload?
maria.fp: I'll pull last 30d usage from billing and share in #finance-private. looping in legal after quote. :thumbsup:
cloudinsight-sales: thanks all — sending updated quote now. happy to hop on call tomorrow 10am PST to walk through.
maria.fp: perfect. tagging this thread as vendor-next-steps.
